verdict.rationale: Azure Cost Management documents budgets with alerts on actual or forecasted cost, and Cost Management APIs for exploring spend, so the budget-and-alert core of the story is first-party. Nothing in the pack documents anomaly detection on spend, and nothing shows these controls are set up from account creation. Missing for 10: documented spend anomaly detection, evidence of day-one or default budget configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration that alerts prevent surprise bills.

support.subject: As a founder, the bill cannot silently explode — budgets, alerts, and documented anomaly detection on spend, configurable from day one

citations.quote: You can configure alerts based on your actual cost or forecasted cost to ensure that your spending is within your organizational spending limit.
The Cost Management APIs provide the ability to explore cost and usage data via multidimensional analysis
